name: pixel-haxe
description: Pixel Api — Hafif ve cok hedefli Haxe API mikro-framework'u. A lightweight, multi-target Haxe API micro-framework. Router, route groups, middleware, CORS, JSON, cookies, Bearer auth, rate limiting, OpenAPI docs and static file serving; runs on Node.js, PHP, Neko and HashLink.
releasenote: v0.3.0: OpenAPI 3.0 dokuman uretici (app.docs + app.describe), istek loglama middleware'i, govde boyutu siniri. OpenAPI 3.0 generator (app.docs + app.describe), request logging middleware and a request body size limit.
